page.overview:
Who is Pedro Diniz?

Pedro Paulo Falleiros dos Santos Diniz (born May 22, 1970 in São Paulo, São Paulo, Brazil) is a Brazilian racing driver, who competed in Formula One between and .

During the 1999 European Grand Prix held at Nürburgring, at the start of the race, Hill's car suffered an electrical failure, making Wurz swerve into Diniz, barrel-rolling his Sauber over. Diniz was unhurt in the crash, but it took several minutes to get him out of the wrecked car.
